newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT- Lehman downgrades Cadbury.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Lehman downgrades Cadbury.

text.p: Analysts at Lehman Brothers cut their rating on Cadbury Schweppes to "neutral" from "buy" on Tuesday in anticipation of an increase in Cadbury's involvement with independent bottlers in the U.S.

The investment bank expects Cadbury to become more directly involved in the bottling network and said that while the actual investment may be limited, more involvement would damage sentiment and was likely to impact on the share price.
Lehman said investors may interpret any direct involvement in the weak bottling business as Cadbury being forced into such an investment to secure a market for its brands.
As a result, Lehman has removed the stock from its European Recommended Portfolio.
